model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and sharpness composition. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 37700, with tick labels displayed at intervals of 7540. The y-axis is labeled "Sharpness composition" and uses a logarithmic scale from -10 to 10, with tick labels at intervals of powers of 10.  A blue solid line begins at approximately (0, -0.1) and increases to approximately (7540, 0.1), then remains relatively stable, fluctuating between approximately 0.05 and 0.15 for the remainder of the x-axis range. An orange solid line mirrors the trend of the blue line, starting at approximately (0, 0.05), rising to approximately (7540, 0.15), and then staying relatively flat, fluctuating from 0.05 to 0.15 along the x-axis. A brown solid line begins at approximately (0, -1) and remains relatively constant, fluctuating between approximately -0.1 and -0.05 for the majority of the x-axis range, then ending at approximately (37700, -0.05).
